phase: source, CPU mapping/numerical proof, plain hostcheck; root approval required before ONE exact resource compile; no ELF/Arena/model/fusion

prior_failure.reason: stride1 direct half fetch packet H/2%8 has DM memory stride2; packet innermost must be contiguous
prior_failure.preservation: original module, source proof, hostcheck and resource failure remain unchanged

contract.shape: BF16 canonical [P512,H3840] input and output, separate owners
contract.arithmetic: absolute-channel SplitMix sign before strides1,2,4,8,16,32, each AddF/SubF RN32; final exactnormal multiply1/8 followed by ONE BF16 RNE cut
contract.scope: finite normal-or-zero inputs and all intermediate results; preserve prior FTZ/overflow exclusions; no changed stage ordering or algebraic reassociation

routing.sign: unchanged HBM BF16 -> local DM -> F32 sign-XOR -> canonical local F32 owner; immutable signs HBM->DM->VRF charged
routing.forward_transpose: actual public collect.transpose.commit from Time[P%4,H/64%15,H/8%8],Packet[H%8] to Time[P%4,H/64%15,H%8],Packet[H/8%8]
routing.stride1: pair bit0 of H%8 in Time, fetch Packet[H/8%8] contiguous; Time[P%4,H/64%15,H/2%4]
routing.stride2: pair bit1 in Time, Packet[H/8%8]; Time[P%4,H/64%15,H/4%2,H%2]
routing.stride4: pair bit2 in Time, Packet[H/8%8]; Time[P%4,H/64%15,H%4]
routing.half_rule: each stage performs two real paired reads and AddF/SubF into distinct halves of one NEW staged F32 owner; both old halves live until both writes complete; existing unzip/narrow/widen order retained
routing.inverse_transpose: actual public transpose back to Time[P%4,H/64%15,H/8%8],Packet[H%8] after stride4, before stride8
routing.stride8_16_32: byte-identical original helper bodies and ordinary contiguous H%8 packets
routing.not_assumed: No alias/reshape substitutes for either transpose. No free XOR partner routing. Public typecheck does not prove backend lowering or runtime values.

public_sdk.limitation: config_transpose calls a prebuilt public FFI verifier; the complete generated fetch/commit constraints still require the separately approved resource gate

source_cost.note: All counts are source-level traffic, not runtime estimates. One half emits N/2 but reads N; each full stage reads2N and writesN. Added transposes each readN/writeN. Extra padding, fetch overhead and schedule lifetimes must be reported from resource.

liveness.source_owner_rule: Forward/inverse transpose retain source and independent destination until commit. Each butterfly retains old and new F32 owner. Sign VRF last use is before forward transpose; actual allocator reuse is not assumed.
liveness.compiler_requirement: report actual physical SRAM/VRF lifetimes and DramStack; preserve failure, no automatic geometry sweep

proof_and_gates.CPU: all 512x3840 coordinates, forward/inverse bijection, packet contiguity and all six pair maps; independent staged simulation versus direct six-stage reference and frozen root16 F32/BF16 vectors
proof_and_gates.source: original module and high-stage/helper bodies byte equality; SDK/dependency hashes; real transpose source and no unsafe reinterpreted layout
proof_and_gates.hostcheck: original Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/toolchain, incremental0/package debug0, exclusive tail256-model target
proof_and_gates.resource: root reviews frozen plan/source first; one fresh empty FURIOSA_OPT_OUT_DIR, exact rotate_input H3840 only; preserve any rejection
proof_and_gates.decision: Legality only. Existing threegraph still needs59-63us additional saving for10percent complete gate before adding rotation. Do not convert cycles to microseconds without clock evidence or infer complete speed from bytes removed.
